messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate after recent canary push (canary-id=canary-2026-03-17-09). Error rate 12% (baseline ~0.2%). P95 latency up to 5.6s. Triggering incident channel and paging oncall.
Sam K: paging oncall — looks tied to Caroline's canary from this morning, tagging @Caroline D. Customers seeing failures on hosted API.
Oncall Pager: ack — taking this. Spawning investigation now. Pulling logs from infer-worker pool.
Lucy M: logs show repeated `CUDA out of memory` on infer-worker-03 and infer-worker-04 starting ~09:13 UTC. Stacktrace indicates new kernel invocation pattern matching q4 quantized path.
Irvine SRE: confirming OOMs and container restarts, node memory climbs steadily after first request. Canary only at ~5% traffic but still enough to surface this.
Caroline D: I'm owner of the canary. Initiating emergency rollback and feature-flag flip. Plan: 1) flip canary model flag -> stable, 2) kick rolling revert of canary deployment, 3) run smoke tests. I'll coordinate live.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rollback-id=rb-1742509876, target-image=redwood/model-stable:v3, started at 09:18 UTC. ETA ~90s for traffic shift.
Sam K: @support — can you triage customer-facing requests? Add note to status page if impact persists.
Oncall Pager: executing flag flip now: `opsctl flags set redwood.enable_canary_model false --env=prod`
Caroline D: flag flip issued. Confirming routing change in proxy: `proxyctl route set /v1/generate -> model=stable`
Lucy M: running smoke curl: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":5}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED"` -> 200 OK, latency 180ms on one control node.
Irvine SRE: watching metrics: errors dropping — 5xx rate fell from 12% -> 1.1% within the first 30s after flip. Continuing to monitor drain.
Caroline D: rollback job completed on canary instances; all canary replicas replaced with stable image. Drain policy applied to old pods (graceful connections).
Oncall Pager: running post-rollback verification: health endpoints, token-level latency, and sample customer queries. Also checking KV cache warm start to avoid latency spikes.
Lucy M: smoke test matrix: 50 synthetic requests across regions eu/us/ap — 0.8% 5xx (most transient), p95 latency back to 210-320ms. No OOM traces in recent logs.
Sam K: customer-impact check: support reports <20 tickets tied to this window, mostly timeouts; no billing anomalies. Recommend update to status page: "degraded — resolved" until further notice.
Caroline D: root cause hypothesis — q4 quantized kernel selection introduced an unexpected allocation pattern under certain batch sizes. Will open a detailed postmortem and revert code path in model runtime. For now, canary is fully reversed.
Irvine SRE: scheduling follow-up: reproduce locally with the canary binary + synthetic workloads, test with smaller batch sizes and KV cache conditions. Assigning to Lucy and Caroline.
Sam K: thanks team. Please keep this thread updated with the postmortem link and any customer comms.
Caroline D: noted — will draft postmortem, include timeline, rollback steps, and mitigations (hotfix + regression tests).
Oncall Pager: incident status: mitigated — error rate stable at 0.3% for last 10m, no new OOMs observed. Closing active paging. :white_check_mark:
Sam K: :thumbsup: Great work. Closing thread when postmortem is linked.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Incident ID INC-2026-03-17-09-1742509876.
